Fort Myers Beach offers convenient access to larger nearby cities and good paddleboarding/kayaking opportunities, including Matanzas Pass, Bowditch Point Regional Park, and Estero Bay. Hotel details, availability, and claims (including complimentary breakfast and exact room views) should be verified directly because they may change.

They have not yet stated travel dates, group size, or budget. Peak season is generally December–April; June–November is hurricane season, with late May/June and September/November potentially offering fewer crowds or lower prices. Current trip-planning ideas include relaxing on Fort Myers Beach, paddleboarding, kayaking, shelling, dolphin-watching, and other water activities. Nearby attractions to consider are Sanibel Island/J.N. Ding Darling National Wildlife Refuge, Fort Myers River District, Edison and Ford Winter Estates, Cayo Costa State Park, and Captiva Island.

A separate earlier trip possibility was Colorado hiking: June–September is warmest and generally offers the most accessible trails; April–May and September–October are quieter shoulder seasons; December–March favors snow activities. The user also mentioned friend Rachel, who has recently moved back to the suburbs, and may plan to visit her; ask for her location and local recommendations when arranging Chicago accommodations. Potential Chicago neighborhoods include the Loop, River North, Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, and West Loop, depending on Rachel’s location, budget, amenities, and transit access.
